payout_quote: With Instant Payout, you'll be able to receive your pay, including tips, from the shopper app up to 3 times per day (7 p.m. to 7 p.m. CT) within an hour of requesting a payout. A transaction fee of $0.49 will be collected from the transfer amount and sent to Stripe Connect.
timing: On demand, up to 3 transfers/day (7pm-7pm CT), typically within an hour. $500 daily limit; withdrawals after 7pm CT are captured the next day. Unrequested balance goes out via weekly direct deposit on Friday.
eligibility: Shipt shopper who has agreed to the Stripe Connect terms in the app and received at least one successful weekly payout via direct deposit; debit card on file (new cards can take up to 24 hours to process).
steps: Receive at least one successful weekly payout via direct deposit from Shipt.
Agree to the Stripe Connect terms and conditions in the shopper app.
Add a debit card under Account > Payment info (allow up to 24 hours for processing).
When Instant Payout is active, tap Withdraw on the main menu, review the balance, transaction fee and checking account, then tap transfer.
catches: $0.49 transaction fee per transfer, collected from the transfer amount and sent to Stripe Connect.
Up to 3 transfers per day (7pm-7pm CT); $500 daily limit; withdrawals after 7pm CT are captured the next day.
Not all earnings are eligible: tips of $50 or more and manually applied bonuses/incentives (including milestone rewards) are excluded and paid weekly.
A new debit card can take up to 24 hours before it can be used for Instant Payout.
Pay varies by market and demand; fuel, maintenance, insurance and other vehicle costs reduce net earnings.
No delivery-count promotion is quoted on the official page.
biggest_catch: Tips of $50 or more are not eligible for Instant Payout at all: a big tip always waits for the weekly payout, so same-day access only covers smaller amounts.

who_pays: Shipt pays your shopper earnings, and Instant Payout pushes them through Stripe Connect to your debit card - the $0.49 per-transfer fee goes to Stripe Connect. Anything you do not withdraw goes out via Shipt's free weekly direct deposit on Fridays.
who_qualifies: You must be an active Shipt shopper who has accepted the Stripe Connect terms in the app, received at least one successful weekly direct-deposit payout, and has a debit card on file. To shop at all, Shipt requires you to be 18 or older, pass a background check, and have a reliable insured vehicle and a valid license.
work_available: Batch availability and pay vary by market and demand - the official page promises no minimum number of orders. In slow markets you may see few or no batches, so nothing about your volume is guaranteed.
what_gets_accepted: You are paid for batches you complete and deliver; canceled or never-completed orders do not pay. Tips of $50 or more and manually applied bonuses (like milestone rewards) are excluded from Instant Payout entirely and only pay weekly. Shipt publishes no exact shopper-rating cutoff tied to instant payouts on the official page - that part is unverified.
costs_and_unpaid_time: Each Instant Payout costs $0.49, deducted from the transfer, and you are limited to 3 transfers per day between 7pm and 7pm CT. Your fuel, maintenance, and insurance come out of your pocket, and time spent waiting for batches and onboarding is unpaid: you only earn on completed batches.
when_cash_arrives: Tap Withdraw in the shopper app up to 3 times per day (7pm-7pm CT), max $500 per day, and money typically lands within an hour, minus the $0.49 fee. Withdrawals after 7pm CT count toward the next day, tips of $50+ and manual bonuses skip Instant Payout and pay weekly, and anything left over deposits free every Friday.
